reviews.review: It is not L4D3. But nothing else gets closer to it.
this is good but the og l4d2 is still better, nothing can change that unless they do a huge very good update worth maybe 15+gb

FIRSTLY I did not play L4D so this opinion of mine will be unaffected by that.

Pretty Good Game but it is no longer supported by the developers and is still over priced, so no do not buy this game unless it is on sale, as there is no more support for it.

What I liked about it, the game is challenging and on the higher levels of difficulty certainly requires teamwork and if you spend the time to learn the basics of the game then even at the highest levels of play you will have great time, usually.

The base story is good, nothing amazing here, though ai teamates/bots are awful so beware they still have not added a basic script after 2 years of content that makes bots crouch when you aim so that they do not take bullets to the face. 

X_X

The DLC story is worse and unbalanced, the DEVELOPERS did clearly not spend enough time working on it and only comes with one act per season, which is ONLY 5 missions long. Which is roughly 4 to 6 missions shorter than the base game content. So yeah DO NOT GET THE DLC UNLESS ITS ON SALE!

Music/Soundtrack is good.

Combat is great, got melee options, ranged options and even support options, ie. Card Decks built around, healing teammates, using explosives or farming for copper which is resource used to buy supplies in game. So depending on how you prefer to play the card deck system is really good and offers lots of customisation and you can play how you want, just got to unlock all the cards first, by playing the game. 
One down side to the card deck system is that you will need the DLC to get the most powerful one time use cards, also known as burn cards, these cards can do things like improve the quality of all explosives by one tier, which can be very useful when you are playing at a high level.

That negativity aside, I would to make the same point once again this one of the few games I've played in the past few years which allows you to play the way you want. While other games may have better soundtracks or better stories or more interesting characters this game offers you a considerable amount of flexibility, which for me personally is very appealing and is main reason I have played this game for over 1000 hours because there are just so many different ways to play, to enjoy this product.

One thing I will also note is that when you find weapon you like, be it a M16 or Fire Axe I would recommend building your Card Deck around the weapon you prefer to use. And unless you have unlocked all your cards and have a good team to work and plan with, do not bother playing on the highest difficulty because prep time, teamwork and voice comms are a must.

In conclusion the game is pretty good, it has it's flaws but all games do. However now the DEVELOPERS HAVE OFFICIALLY STOPPED SUPPORTING THE PRODUCT and it's still overpriced and there is no mention of that fact on the main steam page I cannot recommend this product, UNLESS you get it at a discount, as this game still has issues that now may never be fixed and without modding support or workshop is it unknown how long this game continue to have an active player base.
